facts.fact: Minister for Communication and Information Technology Angella Kairuki said on 2026-09-11 that the digital agenda is aligned with the '10-year Digital Economy Strategic Plan to 2034', so its stated period runs to 2034 and had not ended; the document does not describe the plan's scope (class left empty), links no text, and does not say it is public. Text public: not stated

note: Class of the Digital Economy Strategic Plan is empty because the document names it only in a list of alignments and does not describe its scope; Vision 2050 and the Fourth Five-Year Development Plan are likewise named only.
